name: Agent Avenue

categories.label: Won
categories.hint: Win by catching the opponent's meeple, having 3 Codebreakers in play, or opponent having 3 Daredevils in play

tiebreakers.description: If both players meet end conditions at once, the active player (whose turn it is) wins

winCondition: Checked in the End step of each turn: catch the opponent's meeple (reach or pass its position) to win; 3 Codebreakers in play wins; 3 Daredevils in play loses. If the agent deck is empty and the opponent cannot play, the player closer to catching the other's meeple wins.

endCondition.description: Ends at the first met win/loss condition in the End step

notes: family: race-to-goal. No points. Two-player game; a team variant for 3-4 players exists (not modelled). Details from rules summaries; official rulebook not downloaded.

sources.title: How to Play Agent Avenue (Merchants of Play)
